Definition: properly, glistening, i.e. a burnished plate; also a flower (as bright-colored); a wing (as gleaming in the air)
BiblicalUsage: 1) flower, bloom; 1a) flower, bloom; 1b) shining thing (of gold plate on high priest's mitre) (metaph.); 2) feather, wing; 2a) meaning dubious
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
